markets.rules_primary: If DEN Broncos D/ST scores at least 1+ touchdowns in the Seattle vs Denver Pro Football game originally scheduled for Oct 15, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to DEN Broncos D/ST in the Seattle vs Denver Pro Football game originally scheduled for Oct 15, 2026. If DEN Broncos D/ST is active but never takes a snap, the market settles to the fair market price before game start. Once DEN Broncos D/ST takes at least one snap, even if nullified by penalty, the market settles based on touchdowns scored. Touchdowns scored on fake punts or field goals by the offensive team do not count as a special teams touchdown.
